project_type: Static offline study-notes website: a single self-contained HTML file (inline CSS/JS, base64 images only) delivered into a Git repo of M.Phil. Clinical Psychology study material. Not a compiled app; the 'build' is correctness of one HTML file that must open and work offline.
language: HTML5 + inline CSS + vanilla JS (ES5-safe IIFE). No frameworks, no build step.
build_system: None. The deliverable is one hand-authored .html file at the repo root. Validation = grep/inspection + opening logic review. No npm/make/cargo.
test_framework: No automated tests. Verification is by grep assertions and code inspection of the single HTML file (offline-safety grep, required-element grep, credit-string grep, id='source-note' absence grep).
build_command: No build. Validation command (offline safety): grep -oin 'http[s]*://[^" ]*\|www\.[^" ]*' Behavioral-Medicine-Unit-II-CNS-Diseases.html | sort | uniq -c  -> must show ONLY http://www.w3.org/2000/svg lines.
test_command: Inspection greps: (1) credit string 'Dango_Psych by Tejas Dangodra | M.Phil. Clinical Psychology' appears in <title>, cover, footer; (2) cover <h1> contains 'Behavioral Medicine — Unit II:'; (3) grep -c 'id="source-note"' == 0; (4) no teaching-PDF names (shreya/BM NOTES/Behavioural Medicines Notes/teaching notes/senior) anywhere; (5) each topic section has an SVG figure, exactly one .mn mnemonic, a .box.key at-a-glance, and a .box.info Answer-flow box.
verification_instructions: 1) Open the file logic: confirm one <!DOCTYPE html> ... </html>. 2) grep offline-safety as above. 3) grep the required structural elements per topic. 4) Confirm the only http is the SVG xmlns. 5) Confirm references section lists only real published books/authors, NOT teaching PDFs, and contains no web addresses. 6) Compare depth/length against the Unit I file (~1500 lines, ~154 KB) — Unit II should be comparable or larger given it has 9 disease/assessment/rehab topics.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No generated/snapshot files are checked in. (Source-extraction text under /projects/sandbox/work is scratch only and must NOT be committed.)
setup_instructions: python3 is available via pyenv (3.11). Source extraction libs live at /projects/sandbox/work/pylibs (PyMuPDF/pymupdf, rapidocr_onnxruntime, pytesseract, PIL, numpy). Use PYTHONPATH=/projects/sandbox/work/pylibs. Already-extracted source text is under /projects/sandbox/work/extracted/. The approved Unit I template is at /projects/sandbox/work/Behavioral-Medicine-Unit-I-Introduction.html (copied from branch feat/behavioral-medicine-unit1-notes) — REUSE its HTML/CSS/JS shell verbatim.
environment_constraints: No external network needed for authoring. Deliverable MUST be fully offline: inline CSS/JS, base64 images only, ZERO external/CDN refs. The ONLY allowed http anywhere is the SVG namespace 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'. No PDF/OCR tools are pre-installed system-wide; the /projects/sandbox/work/pylibs path provides them. PGI battery manual and some neuropsych PDFs are image-only and need OCR (rapidocr).
contribution_requirements: Work on branch feat/behavioral-medicine-unit2-notes (already created off main). Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles that). Commit only the single new HTML file. Do NOT commit scratch extraction files. No fabrication of facts/authors/dates/pages. Reader-facing text must NOT mention OCR/Python/scripts/repository/tooling, and must NOT name the teaching PDFs.
key_patterns:
Unit I template conventions to replicate EXACTLY: pastel :root theme; fixed ~300px left #side sidebar with offline debounced search (live #searchStatus + Prev/Next/Clear, Enter=next, Shift+Enter=prev, Esc=clear) + nested TOC; #menuBtn toggle at <=1050px; #topBtn back-to-top; .skip skip-link; smooth scroll; IntersectionObserver active-link highlighting; .toolbar Expand all/Collapse all/Print. Box classes: .box.def (lavender, 'Characterisations by standard texts' — ONLY where a genuine sourced definition exists), .box.key (mint, 'at a glance'), .box.info (sky, 'Answer flow'), .box.warn (peach), .box.ex (butter), .box.law (rose). .tag chips (guide/theory/code/eg/sec). .mn mnemonic box (exactly ONE per topic). .tw scrollable tables. collapsible
with +/- markers. Glossed-term convention: term (plain meaning). figure.fig with inline
